preconditions: Explicit local/Git sources or verified unconfigured whole-project Baseline snapshots, with canonical Baseline IDs or supplied record bytes; source project identity must match.
steps: Acquire owned comparison sources with their actual bytes, project identity, schema and artifact-path checks; historical Baselines use only their record and archive objects.
Compare Baseline pairs with the shared semantic-diff contract and independently materialized projects, preserving source bytes and existing local/Git behavior.

Verify every archived object and reconstructed root, retain immutable source evidence, and reject missing/tampered bytes and unsupported opaque resource deltas. Successive Baselines compare stored history records through the same artifact diff.

oracle.requirement_contract: `specroad baseline compare <A> <B>` MUSS die in den Baseline-Objektspeichern gesicherten Inhalte lesen und denselben strukturellen und semantischen Diffvertrag wie `specroad diff` verwenden.
oracle.scope: Owned local/Git/Baseline source registry for project configuration and artifact fields. Baseline IDs or supplied record bytes load the already supported archived whole-project snapshot and bind its verified record/root/object hashes. The same compare_sources/compare_semantic path yields the field diff. Historical archive objects are represented by their verified stored Baseline record fields; other resource bytes remain opaque and differing inventories fail. Baseline/bundle CLI discovery, complete resource semantics and full semantic validation are not claimed.

open_items: Baseline CLI/Work integration, verified Bundle providers and selected/configured historical-snapshot readers remain separate integrations.

Only project configuration and artifact fields are compared. Profiles, rules, mappings, attachments and registry bytes remain opaque; differing opaque inventories fail, including mixed local/Baseline snapshots whose local reader has not observed binary payloads. No full-model equivalence, atomic observation, historical validation or write/release authority.
